title: Understanding Total Variance
text: The total variance of a centered and scaled design matrix is equal to the number of features (columns) in the matrix.

title: Counting the Features
text: Look at the number of columns in the dataframe. Each column represents a feature.

title: Number of Features
text: How many columns are there in the dataframe?

title: Conclusion on Total Variance
text: The total variance is equal to the number of features, which is the number of columns in the dataframe.
